notes.title: New Official Patch Version Release
notes.content:
Dear players, we have just released a new patch version,with changes below:
1, Redesign the hint system, make the hint more clearly.
2, Optimize the sound which may bother player when playing game.
3, Other performance optimize.

What's more, our new VR Maze Game called"maze of gaea" will release very soon.

notes.title: The first patch version in on schedule
notes.content:
We are planning to release the first patch version, in order to repair some known issue about this version.
They are:
1,more humanized in game tips
2,less floor sound
3,bgm optimize.

Everyone can feedback more issue here, and we will try fix it next build.
